d: Kango, kenya aur naijiriya jaise deshon men ibola ke mamlon ki vaishvik khabron ke bich barhti vaishvik chinta ko dekhte hue kendr sarkar ne sabhi rajyon aur kendrashasit pradeshon ko satark kar diya hai. sabhi rajyon aur kendrashasit pradeshon ko ibola ke sanbhavit khatre se nipatne ke lie mok dril aayojit karne ka nirdesh diya gaya hai. ismen sandigdh marijon ki pahchan se lekar ilaj, aaisoleshan aur sainpal transporteshan tak ki taiyariyon ko parakhne ko kaha gaya hai.
